title: PILLAR: Private Inverted-Index Lexical Lookup for Augmented Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.36326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) hands the user's query to whoever hosts the corpus. We propose PILLAR, a Privacy-Preserving RAG (PPRAG) system based on Private Information Retrieval (PIR) in which a client utilizes the k documents most similar to their query from a server-held and publicly known corpus to respond to their query, while the server learns nothing about the query, either its terms or its access pattern. Prior PPRAG constructions rely on dense retrieval alone, translating approximate nearest-neighbor search into many query-dependent rounds of PIR, and pay for it in both latency and retrieval quality. PILLAR instead performs private hybrid retrieval in two stages. A sparse stage issues a small, fixed number of PIR queries against a carefully designed index of precomputed BM25 scores, filtering the corpus down to candidates that share terms with the query without the server ever seeing which terms these are. translated_title: PILLAR：面向增强检索的私有倒排索引词汇查找
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）会将用户的查询交给语料库的托管方。我们提出PILLAR，一个基于私有信息检索（PIR）的隐私保护RAG（PPRAG）系统：客户端从服务器持有且公开已知的语料库中获取与其查询最相似的k篇文档来回应查询，而服务器对查询一无所知——既不知道查询的词项，也不知道其访问模式。先前的PPRAG构造仅依赖稠密检索，将近似最近邻搜索转化为多轮依赖查询的PIR请求，在延迟和检索质量两方面都付出代价。PILLAR改为以两个阶段执行私有混合检索：稀疏阶段对精心设计的预计算BM25分数索引发起少量固定次数的PIR查询，将语料库过滤为与查询共享词项的候选文档，而服务器始终看不到这些词项是什么；稠密阶段（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: PILLAR提出一种基于PIR的两阶段私有混合检索隐私保护RAG系统，通过稀疏阶段（基于预计算BM25索引的少量固定PIR查询）与稠密阶段相结合，在服务器完全无法获知查询词项和访问模式的前提下，同时兼顾检索质量与低延迟。
